findings.message: Null note to UI. The listener passes `newValue` straight to `showNote`, but the model sets the property to `null` in several cases: `plan` with no date, a date with no notes, or `setAddressBook` clearing notes. The constructor guards against `null` before calling `showNote`, which suggests `showNote` does not handle `null`. If it dereferences the note, switching to a date with no note will throw an NPE on the FX thread. Even if it doesn't, the previous note may stay visible instead of being cleared or hidden. Handle `null` explicitly, for example by clearing or hiding the note area.

Note order lost. `AddressBook` keeps notes in a `LinkedHashMap`, and `updatePlannerNote` merges matching notes in insertion order. The JSON layer uses a `HashMap`, so insertion order is lost on save and reload. After restarting the app, merged planner notes for a date (e.g. an `everyday` note plus a specific-date note) can appear in a different, hash-dependent order. Use a `LinkedHashMap` here to keep the order stable.
